title: Power Apps: build model-driven apps with Copilot Cowork
summary: Hold: the briefing treats Dataverse capacity consumption as unpublished, although Microsoft's platform documentation explicitly includes tables and metadata created by custom model-driven apps. It also carries security-role creation over from the code-tools skill without evidence that the planned Cowork skill has that capability. The roadmap dates and the documented control paths and commands check out.
